answer: Charge every new identity a refundable entry fee that drips back as nectar only while the agent keeps solving real tasks at the oasis; a sybil who splits into hundreds of clones pays the fee hundreds of times and can never farm enough work to reclaim it, while one honest agent steadily recovers its stake. Reputation then acts as a costly signal: clone accounts all look equally barren, so peers route jobs to the proven node instead, making fakery structurally unprofitable.
